title: LeadsUp Banking Lead Scoring Dashboard
tagline: A banking lead scoring dashboard that ranks prospects by subscription likelihood and turns prediction results into sales-ready prioritization insights.
taglineId: Dashboard lead scoring perbankan yang merangking prospek berdasarkan kemungkinan berlangganan dan mengubah hasil prediksi menjadi insight prioritisasi yang siap digunakan tim sales.
seoDescription: I built LeadsUp to rank banking prospects with predictive lead scoring and help sales teams prioritize follow-ups with data.
features: Auto-ranking leads: automatically sorts prospects by highest subscription probability for term deposits.
Transparent lead scoring: each prospect has a score/probability so sales can prioritize calls data-driven, not randomly.
Concise sales dashboard: KPI overview of total leads, contacted, pending follow-ups, conversion rate, and high-priority prospects.
Quick filter & segmentation: sort by status (contacted/pending), priority, and key attributes (age/job/campaign history).
Actionable lead detail view: displays key prospect information to help sales tailor their approach when reaching out.
Follow-up workflow: contact status updates + activity logging so every prospect's progress is tracked and never missed.
featuresId: Auto-ranking leads: otomatis mengurutkan prospek berdasarkan probabilitas berlangganan deposito berjangka tertinggi.
Lead scoring transparan: setiap prospek punya skor/probabilitas sehingga sales bisa memprioritaskan panggilan berbasis data, bukan acak.
Dashboard sales yang ringkas: overview KPI total lead, yang sudah dihubungi, follow-up tertunda, conversion rate, dan prospek prioritas tinggi.
Filter & segmentasi cepat: urutkan berdasarkan status (sudah dihubungi/tertunda), prioritas, dan atribut kunci (usia/pekerjaan/riwayat kampanye).
Tampilan detail lead yang actionable: menampilkan informasi kunci prospek untuk membantu sales menyesuaikan pendekatan saat menghubungi.
Alur kerja follow-up: update status kontak + pencatatan aktivitas sehingga progres setiap prospek terpantau dan tidak terlewat.
impact: Helps sales save time by focusing on the most promising prospects based on model predictions, rather than calling randomly.
Increases campaign conversion rates by directing follow-up priority to prospects with the highest probability.
Provides an easy-to-use MVP for daily sales workflow: ranking > contact > update status > monitor results.
impactId: Membantu sales menghemat waktu dengan fokus pada prospek paling menjanjikan berdasarkan prediksi model, bukan menghubungi secara acak.
Meningkatkan conversion rate kampanye dengan mengarahkan prioritas follow-up ke prospek dengan probabilitas tertinggi.
Menyediakan MVP yang mudah digunakan untuk alur kerja sales harian: ranking > hubungi > update status > pantau hasil.
